from_node.description: Engineering design translates needs into requirements/specifications, iterates through prototypes, negotiates trade-offs and increasingly treats the artifact life cycle as part of design.

to_node.description: Technical design is exhausted by one single optimization criterion of calculative efficiency and therefore automatically instantiates maximal Gestell.

bridge.statement: Contemporary design is multi-criteria, iterative and value/goal laden; calculation and optimization can be important without exhausting design rationality.

to4.criteria_tradeoffs: multiple requirements and criteria create trade-offs; no single generic optimum is guaranteed
to4.governance: design requirements, review and testing procedures constrain decisions
to4.control_responsibility: responsibility is distributed across design, production, deployment and institutional actors
to4.corrigibility: prototyping, testing and iterative revision make parts of the process explicitly corrigible
to4.material_environmental_dependency: materials, production, operation and disposal constrain designs
to4.native_method: engineering design methodology and artifact analysis
to4.revision_trigger: a design domain in which multi-criteria/iterative description fails and one ordering logic actually explains the system substantially better
